europe_now.title: Fatal Rail Disaster in Spain
europe_now.summary: At least 68 people were killed and over 100 injured following a high-speed train crash in Spain. Officials stated that the collision occurred after a train was erroneously cleared to proceed.

europe_now.title: EU Natural Gas Prices Surge
europe_now.summary: European natural gas prices exceeded 100 euros for the first time since 2022, signaling mounting energy market pressures across the continent.

top_stories.title: EU-Canada Relations
top_stories.summary: Canada and the European Union dropped an associate membership plan during efforts to strengthen bilateral ties. Officials are utilizing a critical window of opportunity to solidify their partnership.

top_stories.title: Border Force Surveillance Powers
top_stories.summary: European Union lawmakers strongly criticized new powers granted to the border force regarding social media surveillance. The legislative pushback highlights ongoing tensions over digital privacy and agency authority.
